title: Passive remote-ref cache
description: Count actual shells and Git launches across a frozen eight-slot remote-ref workload, then prove authenticated run create, prepare, dispatch and cancel on an owned temporary gateway.

ref-budget.intent: Published workspaces retain their real verdicts while default and publication queries reuse exact remote/ref/authority observations. Count shells and nested Git launches over 630 logical seconds; every fixture and background child is cleaned.

dispatch-smoke.intent: Authenticated run.create reaches write-task, prepare and dispatch, then cancels and releases the owned fixture. Use the supplied immutable FARMSLOT_CLI and a fresh FARMSLOT_SAFE_IDLE_PROOF_OUT; never allocate a real farm slot.
